summary: Enhance your skills with our Product Management Training Course. Learn essential strategies and tools to excel in product development and management.
lede: Managing a product means turning customer evidence and business goals into decisions about what to build, deliver and measure. This course is for professionals already contributing to product decisions who need a disciplined way to validate ideas, prioritize features and plan launches with measurable outcomes. Participants practice customer discovery and hypothesis validation, build roadmaps using MoSCoW and Kano, and develop user stories, product KPIs and go-to-market plans with cross-functional teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already contribute to product decisions and need a more disciplined way to validate ideas, prioritize features, and launch products with measurable outcomes.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in product, business analysis, project delivery, marketing, operations, or digital transformation. Prior exposure to Agile, Scrum, or customer research helps, but it is not mandatory. You do not need coding skills to complete the course, although familiarity with product analytics dashboards, spreadsheet-based analysis, and collaboration tools will help you move faster. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational and hands-on application level, not as technical engineering or software development training.
